bodyHtml:
🖥️ Tailored Builds · Logan & Surrounds

Custom Computer Builds Logan. Your Dream PC, Built For You.

Whether you're an elite gamer, content creator, engineer or business professional, Computer Repairs Logan designs and builds custom PCs around your exact needs, with premium, handpicked components, thorough testing and benchmarking, and both onsite and drop-off options available.

Build My PC
✓ Tailored To Your Use Case
✓ Premium, Handpicked Parts
✓ Fully Tested & Benchmarked
✓ Warranty On Parts & Labour
Build Categories

Our Comprehensive Custom PC Build Categories.

🎮

Gaming PCs

Built with cutting-edge CPUs like the Intel Core i9-14900K or AMD Ryzen 9 7950X and top GPUs such as the NVIDIA RTX 5090 or AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX, with liquid cooling, quiet fans and RGB where you want it, tailored to the games you actually play.

🏗️

CAD & 3D Modelling Workstations

ECC memory support, redundant cooling and stability-focused builds using Intel Xeon W-series or AMD Threadripper PRO CPUs with NVIDIA RTX A6000 or AMD Radeon Pro GPUs, built for heavy CAD software and 3D rendering.

🎬

Video Editing & Content Creation PCs

NVMe SSDs and up to 128GB of DDR5 RAM for ultra-fast boots and real-time 4K editing, with high-speed rendering CPUs and GPUs tuned to your editing software of choice.

🖨️

Office & Productivity Machines

Silent, space-saving builds using efficient CPUs like the Intel Core i5-13400 or AMD Ryzen 5 7600, fast, dependable and upgradable, without the price tag of a brand-name "business PC".

🛠️

BYOP (Bring Your Own Parts)

Already got a CPU, GPU or case? We handle assembly, BIOS updates, thermal paste and cable management, then stress-test for thermal throttling, compatibility and bottlenecks.

🔧

PC Upgrades

Not ready for a full rebuild? We upgrade RAM, storage, GPU or CPU and tune the BIOS on your existing system instead.

Hardware Brands We Trust

Every Component, Handpicked.

  • CPUs. Intel (i5, i7, i9, Xeon), AMD Ryzen & Threadripper.
  • GPUs. NVIDIA RTX 5090, 4080, A6000, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX.
  • RAM. Corsair, G.Skill, Crucial (DDR5, ECC).
  • Storage. Samsung, WD Black, Seagate (NVMe, SSD, HDD).
  • Cases & Cooling. NZXT, Cooler Master, Lian Li.
  • Motherboards. ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte.
Custom vs Prebuilt

What's Best For You?

Prebuilt PCs

  • Pros. Faster availability, full-system warranties, plug-and-play simplicity.
  • Cons. Limited airflow and upgrade options, bloatware, lower-tier components hidden behind brand names, and often patchy post-purchase support.

Custom PCs By Computer Repairs Logan

  • Tailored to your use case, gaming, CAD, editing or business.
  • Premium components handpicked for quality and reliability.
  • Future-ready designs that are easy to upgrade later.
  • Tested & benchmarked for peak performance before handover.
  • Local expert support from a real technician, not a call centre.
Build My PC
Frequently Asked Questions

Custom PC Build Questions, Answered.

What's the turnaround time for a custom PC build?

Most builds take 3-7 business days, depending on component availability and build complexity.

Can I choose specific brands for my components?

Yes, you can choose trusted brands like Intel, AMD, Corsair, ASUS, MSI and more for every component.

Do you offer water cooling?

Yes, choose between an AIO (closed-loop) or a fully custom water cooling system for maximum performance and style.

Can you build a compact PC for a small space?

Yes, we specialise in SFF (Small Form Factor) builds using Mini-ITX cases and compact, power-efficient parts.

Can you build a PC ready for VR gaming?

Absolutely, VR-ready builds are tested for compatibility with Oculus, HTC Vive and other platforms.

What support do you offer after the build?

We offer ongoing hardware support, diagnostics, and help with future upgrades or troubleshooting as needed.

Do you offer data migration from my old PC?

Yes, we securely transfer your files, preferences and software to your new system as part of the build.

What warranty comes with the build?

We include a warranty covering both parts and labour.

Do you provide consultations to help choose parts?

Yes, we offer one-on-one consultations to plan every part of your build around your goals and budget.

Related Services

Build Sorted, What's Next?

Once your new machine arrives, our new computer setup service gets it configured and ready to use, and data backup and transfer moves your files across from the old one. If you'd rather upgrade an existing machine instead of a full rebuild, see hardware installs and upgrades. Building for a business? Our business IT support team can help with fleet builds and ongoing maintenance.

Let's Build Your Dream Machine.

Whether it's an RGB-heavy gaming rig, a quiet workstation, or a lean business PC, we're here to help from start to finish.
